message.content: According to the conversations, Wolfgang is specifically looking for a set of drums that offer versatility, suitable for both rock and softer tunes like The Beatles. In one of his messages, he mentions his goal to find something that "sounds great but won't break the bank" and hopes to achieve a sound that can accommodate various musical genres. Additionally, he has shown interest in certain brands such as Pearl and Yamaha, and he also expressed interest in checking out the PDP Concept series, which he believes offers a good range of affordable options. Thus, Wolfgang is primarily focused on finding a drum set that can serve multiple purposes and meets his budget constraints.
